Once you’ve created your researcher account please let me know and I’ll add you to the platform. All best Magda ***************************************************************************** To test your sample study from the participant's perspective, please follow the instructions below: Install the Avicenna mobile application on your smartphone. You can find the iOS app here and the Android app here. Launch the app and sign up as a new participant. Please note that you need to use the provided email address(es) as your username but you can choose your own password. When you are asked to enter the study registration code, enter the provided Study ID and follow the instructions. Check this document to learn more about this registration process. - Study ID: 3950 - Participants’ usernames: participant1@essex.ac.uk Magda participant2@essex.ac.uk Giulia participant3@essex.ac.uk Paul Mc participant4@essex.ac.uk Annette participant5@essex.ac.uk Jon participant6@essex.ac.uk Jim participant7@essex.ac.uk Sam participant8@essex.ac.uk Owen participant9@essex.ac.uk Fi C participant10@essex.ac.uk Moreover, if you and your team members would like to also try the researcher's side of our platform, you can create a researcher account here using the email addresses you shared with me earlier. Once done, please let me know so that I can add you as researchers to Study ID: 3950. As researchers, you will be able to access the sample study in your researcher dashboard. Alternatively, if you prefer to join the study as participants using your organizational email addresses, please inform me so that I can invite the email addresses you shared before as participants. If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
